questions.subject: physics
questions.content: Which of the following statements about the instantaneous axis (passing through the centre of mass) is correct?

options.content: It is vertical for both Cases (a) and (b).

It is vertical for Case (a); and is at 45<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="0.988ex" height="1.532ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -677 436.6 677" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(33,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> to the xz-plane and lies in the plane of the disc for Case (b).

It is horizontal for Case (a); and is 45<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="0.988ex" height="1.532ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -677 436.6 677" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(33,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> to the xz-plane and is normal to the plane of the disc for Case (b).

It is vertical for Case (a); and is 45<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="0.988ex" height="1.532ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -677 436.6 677" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msup"><g data-mml-node="mi"></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(33,363) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="2218" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2218"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> to the xz-plane and is normal to the plane of the disc for Case (b).

questions.explanation: As depicted in the figure shown here, when the system, as a whole, turns by 180, the disc also turns by 180 about its vertical axis. Hence, the instantaneous axis that passes through the centre of mass is vertical in both cases (a) and (b).
